about.title: Yoga Instructor
about.bio: I teach yoga as a practice that serves your whole life — building strength, flexibility, breath awareness, and the mental clarity that helps you perform better in sport, work, and everything in between. Every class I teach meets students where they are today.

hero.headline: Breathe. Move. Restore.
hero.subline: Private yoga instruction — vinyasa flow, athletic recovery, and mindfulness-based practice for students who want to feel as good as they perform.

packages.title: Beginner Series
packages.description: 6-week introduction to yoga — foundational poses, breath work, alignment principles, and a gentle flow practice. 2 sessions per week designed to build a sustainable habit.

packages.title: Athletic Recovery Program
packages.description: Specialized 8-week program for athletes — hip opening, thoracic mobility, hamstring and shoulder flexibility, and breath techniques for recovery and nervous system regulation.

packages.title: Private 1-on-1 Sessions
packages.description: Personalized private sessions tailored to your goals — injury recovery support, sport-specific mobility, advanced postures, or personal wellness practice.

faq.question: Do I need to be flexible to start yoga?
faq.answer: Absolutely not — flexibility is a result of yoga practice, not a prerequisite. Every class includes modifications for all levels.

faq.question: What style of yoga do you teach?
faq.answer: Primary instruction is Vinyasa flow with elements of Yin and restorative yoga depending on the program. Athletic recovery sessions focus on targeted mobility and breath work.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at a local studio or outdoor location. Home sessions available on request. Location confirmed at booking.

faq.question: What should I bring?
faq.answer: Comfortable athletic clothing, a water bottle. Mats, blocks, and straps are provided — or bring your own.

faq.question: Can athletes use yoga for injury prevention?
faq.answer: Yes — many of my clients are athletes who use yoga specifically for mobility, recovery, and injury prevention. The Athletic Recovery Program is designed exactly for this.
